posts.cooked: I know it's old news that Revo Corp takes Plague Rat into custody following his first defeat, but I marked spoilers just in case.  I just wanted to point out that I (and I'm sure everyone else if I noticed it  ) noticed that when you defeat Plague Rat in the video game, you can see the Revo Corp logo on the manacles in which he is being held.  I thought that was a really cool touch.

Chrono:

I thought Baron Blade ran the medical testing that gave Setback his powers. Does he own or work for this evil corporation?

posts.name: bluedarky
posts.cooked:
The thing is that we know that the owner of RevoCorp is Revenant, this leaves 3 possibilities:

  1. RevoCorp is a dummy corporation really lead by Baron Blade. - Unlikely as I recall RevoCorp being mentioned as having goverment contracts and the government should do research into all companies it has contracts with to avoid this situation.
  2. RevoCorp does work for anyone who has the money. - Possible
  3. Baron Blade works for RevoCorp. - Again possible.
